title: Full reach at the sides that are not powers of two
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-10, before the proof attempt and before the census runs. Target B1: full reach (every contact reads some contact of every ring) at every side n >= 3 that is not a power of two from 8; to be proved for as large an infinite family of sides as can be reached, or the obstruction stated. B2 (computed, the stress test one size past the census to 50 and 64): every side from 3 to 130, with the powers of two 4 to 128 run exactly over a full period of the walk. Predicted: full reach at every side but 8, 16, 32, 64, 128; at 128 exactly 124 contacts miss a ring, each the three rings of one corner, and 404 = 3n + 20 contacts miss some contact.
failure_conditions: A side from 3 to 130, not 8, 16, 32, 64 or 128, where some contact misses a ring.
At 128, a failing set other than the predicted 124 contacts.
remaining_obligations: B1 by proof for an infinite family, or the obstruction
B2, the census, as a registered long-running check
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2). Reach is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared beyond which contacts each ring holds (A45).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's pick of B59 on 2026-11-10, relaying the owner's go-ahead for a harder 3/3 direction.
validation.status: pre-registered; the proof attempt to follow
